posts.title: Dismantling Weight Bias in Eating Disorder Treatment: How to Support Patients in Large Bodies

summary_en: A free 90-minute live webinar from Equip Academy, presented by clinical psychologist Dr. Savannah Erwin and Ally Duvall. It explains why weight bias harms eating disorder care: fewer than 6% of people with eating disorders are underweight, yet people in larger bodies are often undiagnosed, misdiagnosed, or stigmatised when they seek help. The session covers three common weight myths and their dangers, key considerations when caring for larger-bodied patients, and strategies to help patients embrace weight inclusivity. Held Tuesday 1 December 2026, 11:30-13:00 Pacific Time (14:30-16:00 Eastern; 03:30-05:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 2 December), live online via TPN.health with on-demand replay, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Full attendance earns CE credit. Aimed at physicians, nurses, dietitians, psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists, addiction counsellors and other healthcare providers.
summary_zh: Equip Academy 免費 90 分鐘網上講座，由臨床心理學家 Savannah Erwin 博士及 Ally Duvall 主講，拆解飲食失調治療中的體重偏見：少於 6% 飲食失調患者體重過輕，但大體型患者往往被漏診、誤診，求助時更面對 stigma。講座講解三大常見體重迷思及其危險、照顧大體型患者的要點，以及協助患者擁抱體重包容的策略。2026 年 12 月 1 日（星期二）美西時間 11:30–13:00 舉行（美東時間 14:30–16:00；香港／澳門時間 12 月 2 日星期三凌晨 3:30–5:00），全程線上直播（TPN.health），亦可按需重溫，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。全程出席可獲 CE 學分。對象為醫生、護士、營養師、心理學家、社工、婚姻家庭治療師、成癮輔導員及其他醫護專業人員。
